tier_key.PROVEN: All 13 Grok gates pass + forward cohort matured. Safe for small live sizing.

tier_key.CANDIDATE_WEAK: Passes n+PF but fails robustness gates (MaxDD, month stability, concentration).
tier_key.FAIL: Fails data integrity (D) or resolution (R) gates, or PF < 1.1, or refuted by peers.
